entities.name: Hammen of Jor
entities.description: Master fighter of the House of Oor-tael in Kush on Dominaria, born with the ability to control mana.

entities.name: House of Oor-tael
entities.description: House Hammen later rebuilt and became Master of.

entities.name: Kush
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where the House of Oor-tael stood.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: Massacre that Hammen escaped by hiding in the sewers.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: City where Hammen lived as a beggar and thief.

entities.name: Garth One-Eye
entities.description: A mysterious stranger, actually Galin, son of Cullinarn.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: Grand Master whose rule Garth challenged.

entities.name: Festival of Estark
entities.description: Festival whose honor Garth sought to rebuild.

entities.name: Time of Troubles
entities.description: Period after which Hammen rebuilt the House of Oor-tael.

entities.name: Norreen
entities.description: Woman Hammen harassed; she and Garth named their son after Hammen.

events.summary: Hammen escapes the Night of Fire massacre by hiding in sewers for weeks, then abandons his spells and lives in Estark as beggar and thief, heading a brotherhood of pickpockets.
events.quote: He was one of few people to escape the massacre, hiding in the city's sewers for weeks.

events.summary: Twenty years later Hammen becomes involved with Garth One-Eye's plans to challenge Zarel and Kuthuman and realizes Garth is Galin.
events.quote: Hammen realized that Garth was Galin, the son of Cullinarn

events.summary: Hammen volunteers to fight in the arena in Garth's stead but is stopped by Garth.
events.quote: Hammen volunteered to fight in the arena in his stead, but was stopped by Garth.

events.summary: After the Time of Troubles Hammen rebuilds the House of Oor-tael and becomes its Master.
events.quote: he rebuilt the House of Oor-tael, becoming its Master

relations.quote: Hammen was Cullinarn 's favorite fighter before the Night of Fire.

relations.note: Helped Garth, who called him 'his servant'.
relations.quote: Hammen started helping Garth out of curiosity
determined to challenge the rule of Grand Master Zarel
